description: EU average feed barley price
source: European Commission, Agri-food data portal (DG AGRI)

notes: Weekly EU-average prices (member-state reports weighted by DG AGRI); aggregated to calendar-month mean of weekly quotes (week assigned to month containing its Thursday). Reporting stage changed with marketing year 2026/27 (from 2026-08, 'Deliver to first customer'); pieces concatenated without overlap (possible small level break).
